name: web-pixel-art-guild-member-cards-with-8-bit-borders-and-role-badges
title: Black page 'The Guild' with six member cards in pixel type and chunky white pixel borders, with ADMIN and MOD badges
whatItIs: A black page with a pixel-font title 'The Guild' and caption, and a 3x2 grid of cards drawn with double white pixel borders, each with a round monogram badge (OD, PK, CM, RR, DM, SS), a bold pixel name, a role line and small ADMIN or MOD tags.
whatItMeans: Nostalgic and playful; pixel borders and type turn a team list into a game roster.
techniques: Draw borders with stepped pixel corners.
Set text in a pixel font.

vocabulary.definition: A border built from square steps.
A typeface designed on a pixel grid.
A tiny label such as ADMIN.
